Hi Lena — thanks for sending this over. Please find our concise answers below and attached a one-page evidence PDF that pulls together policy excerpts and our SOC2 reference. Happy to hop on a call if you want line-by-line review.

Summary (hosted API):
- Regions: Hosted API is region-aware. Customer traffic can be routed to and served from US, EU (Frankfurt), or APAC (Tokyo) cloud regions depending on account configuration. By default accounts are created in the US; Meridian can request EU regioning at onboarding and we will scope data residency for your account.

- Default retention (hosted API):
  * Request/response payloads: Ephemeral by default — not persistently stored beyond transient processing. We retain payloads for up to 24 hours in a short-term troubleshooting buffer then purge automatically.
  * Debug traces & operational logs: Aggregated operational logs (no raw payloads) retained for 90 days for performance/ops telemetry.
  * Embeddings & customer-provided data: Not stored unless customer explicitly enables the "persist artifacts" option. If enabled, stored artifacts have a configurable TTL up to 90 days.

- Customer-initiated erasure & account deletion:
  * Live data purge: When a customer requests tenant deletion, we enact immediate deletion of tenant-scoped artifacts (user-managed storage, optional persisted artifacts) within 30 days.
  * Verification: We provide a deletion confirmation report and timestamped audit evidence after the purge completes.
  * Backups & snapshots: Nightly infrastructure snapshots may contain transient copies for disaster recovery; those backups are encrypted at rest and rotated. Snapshot data is retained up to 60 days and is subject to the same encryption controls; we exclude backups from long-term retention of customer payloads unless explicitly requested and contracted.

- Key management & encryption:
  * Data in transit and at rest is encrypted by default. Hosted customers may elect to use customer-managed keys (CMKs) via cloud KMS (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK) on enterprise plans — we can document the CMK flow for Meridian.

- Audit & evidence:
  * We have SOC 2 Type II and can share the report under NDA. Security-event audit logs (access, config changes) are retained for 13 months.

Notes & exceptions:
- If your regulatory posture requires >90-day retention for full request payloads or a hard EU-only guarantee, we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment options. Those deployments allow contractual region lock and longer archival retention options.
- We can offer a scoped 12-month retention exception on Hosted with a contractual amendment and elevated controls, but that will require review by Product and Security (CC'd).

Attachments: Redwood_Meridian_Residency_Retention_Answers.pdf (one-page summary)
